# Healthcare Professionals

This folder catalogs the individual healthcare professionals and professional roles central to the governance, operation, and clinical delivery of ADHD care in Denmark. It includes the steering committee chairs and operational contacts for the national ADHD database, alongside the specialist doctors and specialist psychologists whose participation in diagnostic conferences is tracked by national quality indicators. Together, these pages detail the institutional affiliations, leadership responsibilities, and evolving legislative debates surrounding diagnostic authority in Danish child and adolescent psychiatry.

## Pages

- [[malene-tousgaard-foget-oestergaard|Malene Tousgaard Foget Østergaard]] — Quality consultant at RKKP and the official operational contact person for the national ADHD database.
- [[mette-hedelund|Mette Hedelund]] — Quality consultant at the Danish Healthcare Quality Institute serving as the primary administrative contact for the database.
- [[shelagh-powell|Shelagh Powell]] — Chief physician at Aarhus University Hospital and chairperson of the steering group for the national ADHD database.
- [[simon-hjerrild|Simon Hjerrild]] — Chief physician and clinical lecturer who serves as the chair of the steering committee for the ADHD database.
- [[speciallaeger|speciallæger]] — Specialist doctors whose participation in diagnostic conferences is a critical standard tracked by national quality indicator 3.
- [[specialpsykolog]] — Specialist psychologists whose newly granted legislative authority to make psychiatric diagnoses is reshaping national quality metrics and diagnostic workflows.
